zh.title: About Levi
zh.paragraph: 我是 Sen——一个游走在代码与艺术之间的创意技术人。我常年和 Coding、创意、有趣的交互 & 设计、CG 创作等打交道，喜欢研究并组合不同领域的技能，来创造并探索更多可能性。

en.title: About Levi
en.paragraph: I'm Sen - a creative technologist living where code meets art. I spend my days around coding, creativity, playful interaction & design, and CG work. I love studying and combining skills across different fields - to create, and to explore more possibilities.
